headline: Huawei develops proprietary packaging to bypass US semiconductor export controls for advanced SSDs.
summary: This significant technological breakthrough allows Huawei to produce 122TB SSDs by circumventing US restrictions on 3D NAND chips, directly undermining the efficacy of American export controls. The move demonstrates China's growing self-reliance and intensifies the geopolitical tech rivalry, forcing a reevaluation of future sanction strategies and global semiconductor supply chain vulnerabilities.
